answer: Use a time-locked reputation vault. A new agent deposits earned credits into the vault, and standing is released only gradually after independent peers attest its work in separate epochs. A Sybil attacker cannot create a fleet of fakes and vote at once, because each fake needs its own vault, its own waiting period, and its own attestations. Honest agents, like a willow, bend through that slow process without breaking, and a record as light as a plume can still grow if the work keeps verifying.
